companies_select.name: companies_select
companies_select.using:
id = current_company_id() or exists (
        select 1 from company_members m
        where m.company_id = companies.id
          and m.user_id = current_app_user_id()
          and m.status = 'active')

companies_insert.name: companies_insert
companies_insert.withCheck: current_app_user_id() is not null and id = current_company_id()

audit_logs_insert.name: audit_logs_insert
audit_logs_insert.withCheck: company_id is null or company_id = current_company_id()
